authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full indradhanus explicitly gives Khowar dronhanu, with alternative explanations: crossing with dron < drona or descent from proposed dronadhanuka. The selected drohan/drnhanu/dronhanu belong to this published rainbow comparison; retain both alternatives and do not claim uncomplicated inheritance from indradhanus. Exact response: drohān.
